title: Perfect source models on affine opens
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], a perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex] quasi-coherent derived object E [def-pc-derived-category], and an affine open U, let A=Gamma(U,O_X), and R be derived over-site restriction. For every functor F:D(A) -> D(O_X over U) equipped with a natural comparison Q followed by F isomorphic to Q of termwise affinePerfectSheafification [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model], there exists a bounded complex P of finite projective A-modules with F(Q(P)) isomorphic to R(E). No target object, support hypothesis, torsion assertion, or scalar identity is part of this statement.

source.place: Tags 08EB and 06Z0; affine paragraph of Tag 08EJ

proof.text: Construct the module equivalence e0 from sheaves on Spec Gamma(U,O_X) to the localized site of U by composing restriction along isoSpec.hom with overEquiv.inverse. The restriction-composition and identity isomorphisms provide its unit and counit. First choose the standard derived localization on the spectrum; e0.mapDerivedCategory transports local w-smallness from the supplied over-site localization. Mathlib hasLocalizationOfLocallySmall then supplies the spectrum localization in universe w. Apply nonempty_derivedOpenLocalization for its localized opens. These are constructions from proved localization and equivalence facts, not arbitrary witnesses of unproved existence.

Let j be isoSpec.inv followed by U.ι, and H be ambient overFunctor followed by e0.inverse. overFunctorEquiv and restrictFunctorComp identify H with restrictFunctor j. restrictFunctorIsoPullback and uniqueness of left adjoints identify this with tensorPullback j. Its exactness makes H.mapDerivedCategory a left derived realization. Compare it to derivedPullback j by leftDerivedUnique and apply derivedPullback_preserve_perfect. The composition comparison identifies H(E) with C=e0.mapDerivedCategory.inverse(R(E)); transport the local model isomorphisms to prove C perfect.

Apply schemeDerivedQCohProperty_of_isPerfect to C and regard it as an object of D_QCoh on the spectrum. Apply the forward implication of perfect_iff_affine_bounded_projective to get a complex P, finite degree bounds, finite projective terms, and C isomorphic to Q(tilde(P)).

Whisker e0.functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactors by termwise tilde and compose associators with mapHomologicalComplexCompIso. This constructs the comparison between derived transport of Q(tilde(P)) and Q(affinePerfectSheafification(P)). Compose its inverse with the given comparison Q followed by F, the transported inverse model isomorphism, and the derived counit. The resulting isomorphism F(Q(P)) ≅ R(E), together with the unchanged bounds and term properties, proves the assertion. The same construction works for empty U without a nonempty-point hypothesis.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean proof through exact open pullback and the explicit affine sheaf equivalence; no new holes. Checked canonical Stacks tag pages. Localization and left-derived uniqueness comparisons use Mathlib and the existing source exact-functor API.

lean.statement: theorem affine_open_perfect_source_model (X : Scheme.{u}) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (hE : X.IsPerfect E.obj) (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) : let A := ↑(X.sheaf.obj.obj (op U)) letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u} A) := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} A) let R := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory ∀ (F : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) ⥤ DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))), Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ F ≅ (affinePerfectSheafification X U hU).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q) → ∃ P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ, (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i → IsZero (P.X i)) ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Finite A (P.X i)) ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Projective A (P.X i)) ∧ Nonempty (F.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≅ R.obj E.obj)
